01For a manufacturing company specialising in metalworking, we carried out a comprehensive…

For a manufacturing company specialising in metalworking, we carried out a comprehensive overhaul of the sewage drainage system at its site in Písek.

The aim of the project was to find a suitable way of connecting the existing building to the public sewer and then to replace the original on-site wastewater treatment with pumping into the sewer network.

The project was demanding both technically and organisationally. The main complication was the very restricted access to the site, which standard construction and handling machinery could not reach. The design, the individual working procedures and the work itself all had to be adapted to this.

02A project divided into three stages

A project divided into three stages

03Stage I – CCTV surveys and locating the sewer connection

Stage I – CCTV surveys and locating the sewer connection

First, we used CCTV surveys to verify the actual condition and route of the existing sewer and looked for a suitable point for the future connection. The information obtained became the basis for planning the next steps.

04Stage II – excavation and installation of the stilling chamber

Stage II – excavation and installation of the stilling chamber

Based on the survey results, excavation and construction work followed, together with the installation of a new stilling chamber. This created the necessary link between the rising main from the future pumping sump and the downstream gravity sewer.

This part of the work, too, had to be adapted to the very limited space and access on the site.

05Stage III – converting the existing WWTP into a pumping sump

Stage III – converting the existing WWTP into a pumping sump

In the final stage we removed the original wastewater treatment equipment from the existing tank and prepared the tank for its new use.

This was followed by the installation of a new sewage pumping sump, including the pumping equipment, connecting pipework, controls and connection to the newly built system.

Once installation was complete, we commissioned the whole system and set up its operation. Wastewater is now pumped to the stilling chamber and then flows by gravity into the public sewer.

06When good cooperation is part of the solution

When good cooperation is part of the solution

With technically demanding refurbishments, the result is not the work of the contractor alone. Cooperation between the client, the designer and the installation team is important too.

We therefore greatly appreciate the active and helpful approach of the client's management, who gave us considerable support during both the preparation and the delivery of the project. Open communication and the opportunity to look for solutions together were very important given the difficult conditions on site.

07We are equally grateful for the excellent professional cooperation with Ing.

We are equally grateful for the excellent professional cooperation with Ing. Milan Rada – Vodohospodář, with whom we worked on the design and technical side of the project.

It was precisely this combination of design preparation, the practical experience of the installation team and the client's active cooperation that made it possible to complete the whole project successfully.

08From the first survey to a working system

From the first survey to a working system

The result is a fully functional sewage drainage system – from the new pumping sump through the stilling chamber to the connection to the public sewer.

This project is a good illustration of how Čistá řešení approaches non-standard water management projects:
